svg.title: The river gravel bar nearest the viewer in late summer: rounded cobbles in light grey, dark grey and tan that grow larger toward the bottom of the screen, patches of silt sand, silvered driftwood, and low willow tufts. A repeating strip over the ground fill (ADR-0042), world y 1280..1920; local y 0 is the level ground line. GENERIC BY CONSTRUCTION: no boat, cabin, sign or figure.
